Hi Lydia —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. To keep momentum on the CAIQ submission, attached is a lightweight mapping template that pairs CSA controls to our internal artifacts. Can you: 

- Review the attached CAIQ-Mapping-Template.xlsx and mark which control responses you need from us as "Required Evidence" vs "Summary Statement" by EOD Thursday (2026-08-06).
- Call out any controls that will need a tech-owner walkthrough (e.g., network segmentation, customer data flows).
- Share any internal naming conventions you use so we map artifacts correctly (example: "ACME-DF-01 = dataflow diagram for ingestion").

For visibility, I’ve looped in Vivek and Karthik to confirm owners and expedite evidence pulls. We expect to provide most artifacts (SOC 2 summary, architecture diagram, encryption certs) within 3 business days for required items.

Best,

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks, that looks helpful. Quick clarifications before my team starts annotating the template: 

1) For "Summary Statement" answers, we usually still request a one-paragraph description plus one representative artifact (e.g., architecture diagram or process doc).
2) For controls related to key management and encryption, please include the KMS provider, key rotation cadence, and any HSM integrations.
3) We will need an updated dataflow diagram that highlights where PHI/PII is processed and where it leaves Acme systems — can you confirm the redwood dataflow attachment you plan to provide will include these overlays?

I’ve attached an initial list of baseline docs we expect on our side (acme-sample-dataflow-diagram.png) and our internal control ID mapping to keep labels consistent. I’ll have our security analyst fill in the template and return it by Thursday EOD.

Attachments: acme-sample-dataflow-diagram.png (stub), ACME-control-index.xlsx (provided separately)

Regards,
Lydia Park
Security Program Manager
Acme Biotech

- When you annotate the CAIQ template, please flag controls where you need an owner walkthrough with a preferred 1-hour window — we’ll book SMEs accordingly.
